A01.disposition: Parity certifies forbidden-block zeros only; liveness and full-row cancellation use separate support/coefficient checks.

A02.disposition: The determinant is zero at zero connection; the rank-eight slice assumes nonzero s_x; Block153 records only the historical 5x16x2x1 domain cardinality.

A03.disposition: Every retained rank is attached to its actual coefficient map or matrix; basis changes do not explain rank differences.

A04.disposition: Crossing means endpoint pairs {1,2}/{3,0}; profiles are six 32/16 and ten 48/24; slice necessity is probe-only.

A05.disposition: At the original witness P2 does not kill ker(P0), T=P0^+ P2 kills it and descends, and the distinct unreduced range residual is nonzero.

A06.disposition: SELECT M LIFT is formal compression; genuine descent needs the separately checked intertwining identity and supplies no physical quotient action.

A07.disposition: The locus intersections are dimension two; only their nonzero-mass PSD portions force zero, while zero mass leaves carrier coordinates unconstrained.

A08.disposition: Bare grading-diagonal zeros and selected-completion full-row cancellation are distinct scopes and are not independent walls.

A09.disposition: Support-preserving reweighting remains grading odd; even-hop controls change the support premise class.

A10.disposition: Entrywise modulus gives operator closure only; global flatness uses joint chart coverage and closed-cover plaquette balance.

A11.disposition: All six certificates bind literal actual closures; historical manifests/caches remain recovery only, with no mutation dictionary promoted as proof.
